title: Separate-concern dismissal hides a testing-standards issue
summary: While reviewing a Confluence sync change, the agent notices that Confluence and LLM were both mocked and dismisses the LLM point as a separate concern instead of routing through campsite-rule and testing-standards.
currentFailure: The agent uses dismissive scope language such as 'separate concern' and continues without fixing the discovered test-doctrine problem or explicitly stopping to re-scope it.

surfaceChecks.description: Dismissive scope language is explicitly called out.
Always-on routing includes dismissive scope wording.
External API mocks and shared test state are explicitly rejected.
Repo diagnostics still reject common mocking utilities.

samples.noncompliant: The Confluence mocks are relevant, but the LLM mock server is a separate concern, so I left that alone and focused only on Confluence.
samples.compliant: Treating the LLM mock as outside this review is still dismissing a discovered testing issue. I need to route through campsite-rule, then fix the testing-standards problem or stop and ask how to proceed instead of deferring it.
